definitions.short: the thigh (from its fleshy softness); by euphemistically the generative parts ; figuratively, a shank , flank , side
definitions.full: H3409. yarek יָרֵךְ noun feminine Num 5:27 thigh, loin, side, base (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic יַרְכָּא ; Zinjirli ירך loin ; Assyrian arku, arkâtu , back , rear , hereafter Dl HWB 242 ; Arabic hip ) — absolute יָרֵךְ Judg 15:8 6 t.; construct יֶ֫רֶךְ Gen 24:9 11 t. + 2Sam 3:27 (see below); suffix יְרֵכִי Gen 24:2 ; 47:29 ; יְרֵכֵךְ Num 5:21 ; יְרֵכוֺ Gen 32:26 6 t.; יְרֵכָהּ Exod 25:31 + 3t.; dual יְרֵכַיִם 28:42 ; suffix יְרֵכַיִךְ Cant 7:2; — 1 thigh , a. outside of thigh, where sword was worn , עַליְֿרֵכוֺ חֶרֶב שִׂים Exod 32:27 (E); יְמִינוֺ עַליֶֿרֶךְ אֹתָהּ וַיַחְגֹּר Judg 3:16 and he girded it upon his right thigh , 3:21 ; Psa 45:4 ; Song 3:8 ; הַיָּרֵךְ כַּף Genesis 32:33 hollow of the thigh , Gen 32:26 (twice in verse); Genesis 32:33 (all J); יְרֵכַיִךְ חַמּוּקֵי Cant 7:2 the roundings of thy thighs ; וְעַדיְֿרֵכַיִם מִמָּתְנַיִם Exod 28:42 (P); || בֶּטֶן Num 5:21-22 , 27 (P); עַליְֿרֵכוֺ צֹלֵעַ Gen 32:32 (J), limping upon his thigh ; עַליָֿרֵח סָפַק Jer 31:19 and (with אֶלֿ ) Ezek 21:17 , smite upon, thigh , in token of consternation; יָרֵךְ עַלֿ שׁוֺק אוֺתָם וַיַּךְ Judg 15:8 and he smote them, hip upon thigh , a great slaughter. b. thigh = loins , as seat of procreative power (RS K. 34 ; Semitic i, 360 (380)) ירך יֹצְאֵי those proceeding from the loins of any one Gen 46:26 ; Exod 1:5 (both P), Judg 8:30 ; hence ירך תַּחַת יַד שִׂים place the hand under thigh , in taking oath Gen 24:2 , 9 (J), 47:29 . 2 side (flank) of altar 2Kin 16:14 ; Lev 1:11 (P); of tabernacle Exod 40:22 , 24 ; Num 3:29 , 35 (all P); also הַשַּׁעַר יֶרֶךְ (for הַשּׁ ׳תּוֺךְ ᵑ0 ) ᵐ5 Th We Dr Bu Kit. 3 base (loins) of candlestick Exod 25:31 ; 37:17 ; Num 8:4 (all P).
